title: Task and Habit Tracker
objective: Build an app to manage tasks, recurring habits and completion history.

milestones.title: Create and edit tasks
acceptance_criteria: Keep code modular and make failures understandable.
Provide a reproducible test or human-review note.

milestones.title: Categories and filters
acceptance_criteria: Keep code modular and make failures understandable.
Provide a reproducible test or human-review note.

milestones.title: Completion history and reminders where supported
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate: completion history and reminders where supported.
Keep code modular and make failures understandable.
Provide a reproducible test or human-review note.

milestones.title: Persistent data and accessible controls
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate: persistent data and accessible controls.
Keep code modular and make failures understandable.
Provide a reproducible test or human-review note.

required_features: Completion history and reminders where supported
stretch_features: Add a focused automated test suite and one edge-case test.
Document platform support, failure handling and data ownership.
Add performance evidence where relevant without optimizing prematurely.

tests.name: Acceptance evidence
criteria: All required features for Task and Habit Tracker are demonstrated.
Normal and failure/boundary cases are tested.
Project builds in the stated toolchain and platform, or its limitations are documented.

tests.name: Source quality
criteria: Functions/types have clear responsibilities and names.
Errors are handled without hiding failures.
Secrets are not committed and untrusted input is validated.

tests.name: Documentation
criteria: Setup and run steps are reproducible.
Known limitations and platform assumptions are stated.
Tests and evidence are recorded honestly.

rubric.criterion: Architecture, data modeling and separation of concerns
Testing, error handling and edge cases
Accessibility, security, reliability or platform fit

review_method: Human review supported by local Swift compilation and tests. The existing CodeLeaf environment does not provide a secure Swift execution runner.
status_note: Draft project; review against the rubric before publication.
